summary: The film premieres globally on Netflix on September 11, 2026.

Netflix


has revealed the official trailer for


Go Team!


, the new comedy created by


Adolfo Valor


and


Cristóbal Garrido


, directed by


Diego Núñez Irigoyen


, and produced by


Zeta Studios


. The film premieres globally on Netflix on


September 11, 2026


.


The film stars


Alexandra Jiménez


(


53 Sundays, The Innocent


),


Maribel Verdú


(


The Final Problem, Elite


),


Pedro Casablanc


(


A Widow's Game, Salvador


), and


Raúl Tejón


(


Alpha Males, Alma


). The cast also includes


Ismael Fritschi


(


Infiesto, REC 4: Apocalypse


),


Blanca Martínez


(


Breathless, In love all over again


),


Víctor Rebull


(


Queen of the South, Alma


), with special appearances by


Saturnino García


(


Shevernatze: A road movie in reverse


) and


Pepe Viyuela


(


The hunt


).


Go Team!


tells the story of Tío Mochales, a company that was once the undisputed king of Spanish cheese. Today, it's a somewhat worn-out business struggling to stay afloat. Its latest big idea? A rural team-building retreat in the village where the company was founded. But what is meant to be a getaway to reconnect with "traditional values" quickly turns into a trap when the employees discover that major layoffs are on the way. What promised to be a motivational retreat becomes an all-out battle of brown-nosing, betrayals, and leaks. A dark comedy about declining offices, ruthless executives, and employees who have had enough of wasting time on the latest team-building trends.


About Zeta Studios


ZETA STUDIOS was founded with the goal of designing, creating, and producing scripted content for leading streaming platforms and content distribution and exhibition markets. Its productions include the series


Élite


, one of Netflix’s most-watched and internationally acclaimed titles,


Olympo


,


When No One Sees Us


, and


The Short Life


, as well as the films


Love & Revolution


and


Leo & Lou.


Upcoming releases include the action comedy


The Trunk


and the series


Secrets of the Courtesan


.

Netflix is one of the world’s leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
